findings.summary: Authority policy tests bind the declared cross-product
findings.evidence: src/guardian-blocking-authority.test.ts now generates the 96-case Cartesian matrix across round, prior-lineage membership, trigger presence, reviewed-diff attribution, exception versus non-exception class, and disposition. `pnpm vitest run src/guardian-blocking-authority.test.ts` passed all 99 tests, including the matrix and separate blank-trigger and preservation assertions.
findings.expected: The policy test must bind the contract's declared cross-product so interactions among round, lineage, trigger, attribution, class, and disposition cannot regress independently.
findings.observed: The table covers rounds 1 and 2, both lineage states, null and reachable triggers, both attribution values, INTEGRITY, DATA_LOSS, and SECURITY_GAP classes, and OPEN and RESOLVED dispositions.
findings.clearCondition: A table-driven policy test covers the declared dimensions, including triggerless and resolved cases for both later-new and prior-lineage findings.
